name: noc-harness
description: NoctusAI harness UX: status line, reminders band, orchestration pane, friction ledger, memory routing, compaction capture, wrap-up nudge. A UX + reliability layer over the canonical Python gates — never a gate itself.

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: Branch/tree, dev divergence, caches and open s1/s2 under the prompt.

reminders_band.title: Reminders band
reminders_band.description: Owner reminders + wrap-up nudge above the prompt.

friction_ledger.title: Friction ledger
friction_ledger.description: Toast + record refused tool calls as auto-improvement s1 events.

memory_routing.title: Memory topic routing
memory_routing.description: Attach a pointer to the matching MEMORY-<topic>.md on each prompt.

compaction_capture.title: Compaction capture
compaction_capture.description: Keep learnings through /compact and record them as s1 events.

wrapup_nudge.title: Wrap-up nudge
wrapup_nudge.description: After a turn that committed, offer the noc-wrap-up check.

executor_offer.title: Executor offer
executor_offer.description: Offer EXECUTOR agent types to the model only once a worktree exists (the Python dispatch rule still enforces).

harness_invalid_alerts.title: Invalid-harness alerts
harness_invalid_alerts.description: Toast + record a Bash red whose output matches a harness-failure signature as INCONCLUSIVE.

semantic_routing.title: Semantic memory routing
semantic_routing.description: When the MEMORY.md table matches nothing, ask memory_search (costs an embedding call; off while OpenAI credits are exhausted).

full_refresh_seconds.title: Full refresh (s)
full_refresh_seconds.description: How often the pane/status full snapshot refreshes.
